# MEHRUH — Project Scope

## 1. Vision
MEHRUH is a luxury haute-perfumery website: luxury perfume campaign + cinematic storytelling + premium ecommerce. NOT a generic Shopify/React/AI template.

## 2. Stack and Constraints
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19
- **Language:** TypeScript strict
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 (design tokens declared via `@theme` in CSS, no `tailwind.config`)
- **Package Manager:** npm
- **Testing & Verification:** Playwright (e2e, visual QA), ESLint 9
- **Motion:** Framer Motion (`framer-motion` v14)
- **Agent Governance:** Agent operating manual and rules located in `.agents/`
- **Constraint:** No new dependencies without explicit owner approval.

## 3. In Scope
- [ ] **S-01:** Brand intro prologue (exists) and hero section with custom cinematic video
- [ ] **S-02:** Tone-aware navbar and accessible cart drawer
- [ ] **S-03:** Core homepage sections: Hero, Brand Story, Collection Intro, Product Grid, Brand Statement, Featured Fragrance, Newsletter, and Footer
- [ ] **S-04:** Dedicated subpages: `/collection`, `/collection/[slug]`, `/our-story`, `/journal`, `/journal/[slug]`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/shipping`, `/contact`, `/faq`, `/care`, and `404`
- [ ] **S-05:** Client-side persisted cart, Pakistani Rupee (PKR) pricing, and strictly typed product data model
- [ ] **S-06:** SEO/metadata, full accessibility compliance, performance optimization, and release hardening
- [ ] **S-07:** GitHub: remote https://github.com/TalhaXaheer/Mehruh, branch main, push at the end of every phase

## 4. Out of Scope
- [ ] **O-01:** Live checkout and payment processing (deferred; decision pending in task 5.4)
- [ ] **O-02:** User accounts, authentication, and customer profiles
- [ ] **O-03:** Order management system, transactional database, and fulfillment backend
- [ ] **O-04:** Content Management System (CMS) integration
- [ ] **O-05:** Third-party transactional email delivery provider integration
- [ ] **O-06:** Multi-currency switching and multi-language localization
- [ ] **O-07:** Formal legal review / certified legal counsel copy
- [ ] **O-08:** Physical boutique / stockist interactive store locator
- [ ] **O-09:** Customer reviews and star rating submission systems
- [ ] **O-10:** Existing auth/Prisma/Stripe code found in repo; not extended until decided.

## 7. Definition of Done
Every task must satisfy this checklist before being considered complete:
- [ ] Only the agreed files changed (listed in task report)
- [ ] `npm run verify` green (`tsc --noEmit && eslint . && next build`)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` green
- [ ] Screenshots at 375, 768, and 1440 attached for every changed section
- [ ] No console errors/warnings, no horizontal scroll, no layout shift on load
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- [ ] Anything uncertain is listed under "Open questions", not silently guessed
- [ ] `docs/PROGRESS.md` updated
